title: The DIME Game
subtitle: Determining Intensity in Asking or Saying No

ask: Very low intensity: consider letting go or not asking.
Ask firmly; insist; negotiate; keep trying.
Ask and don't take no for an answer.
say-no: Very low intensity: consider saying yes or letting go.
Do what the other person wants without being asked.
Do it, even if you're not cheerful about it.
Do it, but show that you'd rather not.
Say you'd rather not, but do it gracefully.
Say no confidently; resist saying yes.
Say no firmly; resist saying yes.
Say no firmly; resist; negotiate; keep trying.

zero_guidance_note: Handout 8's exact response table begins at level 1. The 0-dime result therefore uses a neutral low-intensity descriptor rather than inventing an exact DBT instruction.

prompt_by_mode.ask: Briefly describe the situation in which you must decide on the intensity of asking for something.
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Briefly describe the situation in which you must decide on how strongly to say no — and when to say yes.

help_by_mode.ask: Who is involved, and what are you considering asking for?
help_by_mode.say-no: Who is involved, and what are you considering refusing?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Is this person capable of giving or doing what you want?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Can you give this person what is wanted?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Is getting your objective more important than maintaining your relationship with this person?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Is your relationship more important than saying no?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Will asking help you feel competent and self-respecting?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Will saying no make you feel bad about yourself?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Is the person legally or morally obliged to do or give you what you want?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Are you legally or morally obliged to give or do what is wanted, or does saying no violate this person's rights?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Are you in a position of responsibility or authority to tell the person what to do?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Is this other person in a position of responsibility or authority to tell you what to do?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Is what you want appropriate and reasonable within the context of this relationship?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Is what the person is requesting of you appropriate and reasonable within the context of your relationship?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Is asking important to achieving a long-term goal of yours?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: In the long term, will you regret saying no?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Do you generally give as much as you get in this relationship?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Do you owe this person a favor — does this person do a lot for you when you ask and need something?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Have you done your research on what the request entails?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Are you well-informed about what you are saying no to? Is the other person clear about what is being asked for?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Is this an opportune moment to ask — is the person likely in the right mood?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Is it good timing for the request?

nodes.title: Your DIME Game result
nodes.body: The closer the DIME total is to $1.00, the more intensely or firmly the source recommends responding.
